title: 1:1 Prep - Customer Health Signals & Hypotheses (AE + CSM)
content:
Meeting: AE (Riley) + CSM (Arjun) 1:1
Date: 2026-03-13 (sync window 30m)
Objective: Align on top customer health signals for high-churn cohort and agree on 3 prioritized experiments to improve retention this quarter.

Agenda (rough):
- 0-5m: Quick status (wins / major escalations)
- 5-12m: Health signal review (metrics + anomalies)
- 12-22m: Hypotheses for churn drivers & proposed tests
- 22-28m: Action items, owners, deadlines
- 28-30m: Quick blockers / ask from product/SE

Context / Why this matters:
- Two mid-market customers in month-to-month have signaled decreased API call volume and slowed rollout. Risk: 30% chance of churn if no targeted intervention per historical pattern (see RINF-789). Need targeted low-effort experiments before next renewal touch.

Snapshot metrics (last 30d):
- Active API keys (cohort: mid-market, signed 2024 Q4): 42 -> 37 (-11.9%)
- Avg daily tokens per active key: 14.2k -> 9.1k (-36%)
- Error rate (4xx/5xx) on production routes: baseline 0.9% -> spike 2.7% (last 7d) - investigate correlated deployments
- Feature usage: Streaming responses usage dropped 48% in the same cohort

Top signals to call out in the 1:1:
- Reduced token volume + decreased streaming usage suggests either product deprioritization or regression in response quality
- Error-rate spike aligns with model rollout on 2026-03-02 (model v2.3.1) — confirm if customer pinned model or auto-upgraded
- Support tickets: 3 tickets in last 14d about slower response latency on dedicated instances

Hypotheses (prioritized):
1) Quality regression from model variant change -> customers reducing calls. Test: revert to previous model (v2.3.0) for 2 pilot keys.
2) Silent client-side config change (timeout/retry) in customer's app -> fewer streaming sessions. Test: short troubleshooting checklist + instrumented client logs for 2 customers.
3) Cost sensitivity after usage-based spike -> customer throttled usage. Test: propose temporary quota bump and cost projection for next 30d; measure reactivation.

Proposed experiments (MVPs):
- Exp A (quick rollback): Ops + Eng to roll v2.3.0 for 48 hours for two pilot customers; monitor error rate and tokens. Owner: Riley (AE) to request rollback; Eng on standby. Target start: 2026-03-16.
- Exp B (client instrumentation): Send short attachable script/snippet for client logging (latency, retry counts). Owner: Arjun -> ship to customer dev leads. Target deliverable: snippet + one-pager by 2026-03-18.
- Exp C (cost-concession): Prepare a 30-day quota bump + cost forecast and propose to customer success playbook. Owner: Riley + Finance contact (Priya). Decision by 2026-03-20.

Talking points / suggested phrasing (for AE to use):
- "We noticed activity dropped and want to run a short test to check if a recent model update impacted your flow — this will only take 48h and helps us rule out platform issues quickly."
- "If it's a client-side config change, here's a snippet we can run to confirm — harmless and telemetry-only."
- "As a short-term accommodation, we're open to a temporary quota bump while we identify the root cause; we'll provide a cost projection so there's no surprise."

Open questions / unknowns (need answers before next sync):
- Did the customer opt into auto-upgrades for model variants? (Action: Riley to ask account team; due 2026-03-13)
- Which dedicated instance(s) are showing latency increases? (Action: Arjun to pull latency per instance from Console; due 2026-03-14)
- Any concurrent infra changes around 2026-03-02? (Action: Eng infra owner to confirm; link in RINF-789)

Risk & contingency plan:
- If rollback not possible due to compatibility, fallback: increase sampling for reranking + enable conservative generation params (max tokens shrink) to preserve latency and inspect impact. Owner: Eng/SE.

Action items (clear ownership + due dates):
- Riley: Confirm auto-upgrade status with customer and propose rollback pilot. Due: 2026-03-13.
- Arjun: Export per-instance latency and error-trace for the cohort, add to RINF-789. Due: 2026-03-14.
- Priya: Draft short cost-projection template for 30-day quota bump (include sample invoice). Due: 2026-03-17.
- Eng on-call (assign): Prepare rollback playbook & quick test checklist for v2.3.0. Notify SRE. Due: 2026-03-15.
- Riley + Arjun: Prep customer-facing email + one-pager for the rollback experiment. Due: 2026-03-15.

Notes to self (Arjun):
- Keep the tone collaborative not accusatory — frame as "quick test" not "forced rollback".
- Pull convo history from Slack thread CA12345 before call — there are hints about client changes.
- Link to playbook PR: playbooks/pull/42 has suggested scripts; clone snippet into our customer email body.

Follow-up cadence:
- Check-in 48h after experiment start (quick 15m sync)
- If positive signal (error rate & tokens recover) -> schedule postmortem + update health playbook + recommend canary rollout process.

Misc small TODOs (quick hits):
- Add the two pilot customer account IDs to the Confluence page HEALTH-1234 (Arjun)
- Create a small Linear ticket for the client-instrumentation snippet (owner: Riley)

End of notes.

Unresolved / parking lot:
- Longer term: evaluate whether streaming pricing or usage UI is causing under-adoption (worth a product discovery next quarter).
- Consider adding a daily health digest for mid-market cohort in Console (low effort) — open with Product during roadmap sync.

-- Arjun
